title: Joys of Spring: Gardening Tips for the Growing Season

sentences: Though March remains chilly, the return of the bright and gently warming sun wakes dormant plants and seeds from their slumber, coaxes birds out to build their nests and beckons to the insects that sheltered through winter in undergrowth, nooks and crannies to emerge and flit about in the cool sun.
This is a period of preparation and renewal.
The garden is stirring.
translations: 尽管三月依然寒冷，但明亮而温和的太阳回归，唤醒了沉睡的植物和种子，引诱鸟儿出来筑巢，并召唤那些在灌木丛、角落和缝隙中过冬的昆虫出来，在凉爽的阳光下飞舞。
这是一个准备和更新的时期。
花园正在苏醒。

sentences: Most plants need at least 10-12 hours of light a day to grow well.
As we emerge from the dark half of the year, in the days that follow Valentine's the sun finally gives us 10 hours of light.
This gradually grows to 12 as we arrive at the spring equinox on 20 March, when day and night are equal.
In the garden, it is a time of ever-increasing growth.
translations: 大多数植物每天至少需要10-12小时的光照才能良好生长。
当我们从一年中黑暗的半年中走出来，在情人节之后的日子里，太阳终于给了我们10小时的光照。
随着我们迎来3月20日的春分，白天和黑夜等长，光照时间逐渐增加到12小时。
在花园里，这是一个生长不断加速的时期。

sentences: Today, the sun is joined in the pale-blue sky by streaks of loose clouds and the air is fresh.
I'm out here to sow seeds for his summer garden: tomatoes, peas, chamomile.
All of these plants are easy to grow, pretty and tasty.
translations: 今天，淡蓝色的天空中，太阳与几缕散云相伴，空气清新。
我在这里为他的夏日花园播种：番茄、豌豆、洋甘菊。
所有这些植物都易于种植，既美观又美味。

sentences: I sprinkle the velvety little teardrop tomato seeds into rows in a single seed tray, each variety divided by a sideways cocktail stick and labelled.
I scatter a fine layer of soil over them and then pop the tray in a basin of water to give the compost a soak.
translations: 我将天鹅绒般的小泪滴番茄种子撒在单个育苗盘的行中，每个品种用侧放的鸡尾酒棒隔开并贴上标签。
我在它们上面撒上一层薄薄的土壤，然后将育苗盘放入一盆水中，让堆肥充分浸泡。

sentences: For some plants, like tomatoes, it is not yet warm enough for reliable germination outdoors.
In the main, a warm home is a good place to get March-sown seeds going, as they don't necessarily need a great deal of light at this stage.
In a few weeks, when their two juvenile leaves have emerged, I will gently prick them out.
Softly pinching one of their delicate leaves between finger and thumb, I'll slip a pencil below their young roots to carefully excavate the plant from its birthplace.
translations: 对于某些植物，比如西红柿，室外温度还不够高，无法确保可靠发芽。
总的来说，温暖的室内是让三月播种的种子开始生长的好地方，因为在这个阶段它们不一定需要大量光照。
几周后，当它们的两片幼叶长出时，我会轻轻地将它们移栽出来。
用拇指和食指轻轻捏住它们一片娇嫩的叶子，我会把铅笔滑到幼根下方，小心地将植株从它的出生地挖掘出来。

sentences: I'll then pop the seedling in a pot all of its own to grow big and strong, and begin to feed the gang of plants with a liquid brewed from nettles and chicken poop.
These tomatoes, being tender, will stay in my house until early May then settle into their forever home in the unheated greenhouse.
translations: 然后我会把幼苗单独放进一个花盆里，让它长得又大又壮，并开始用荨麻和鸡粪酿制的液体肥料来喂养这群植物。
这些番茄苗很娇嫩，会在我家里待到五月初，然后安顿在它们永久的家——那个没有暖气的温室里。

sentences: Despite there now being enough light for tender plants to grow outside, it is still too cold for them.
A sunny windowsill, warm conservatory or porch will do them well until the frosts pass, and day and night temps consistently reach 8-10C.
translations: 尽管现在已有足够的光照让娇嫩的植物在户外生长，但对它们来说仍然太冷了。
在霜冻过去、昼夜温度持续达到8-10摄氏度之前，阳光充足的窗台、温暖的温室或门廊对它们来说都是不错的选择。

sentences: Some seeds like to germinate in the light of the sun.
Chamomile is one such customer.
The minute, dust-like seeds float down from my fingers on to the compost.
I leave them there and their tray joins the tomatoes to soak.
A hardy crop, once germinated in the warm chamomile, will move into the unheated greenhouse.
translations: 有些种子喜欢在阳光下发芽。
洋甘菊就是这样的种子之一。
那些微小如尘的种子从我的指尖飘落到堆肥上。
我把它们留在那里，它们的托盘和番茄一起浸泡。
这种耐寒作物一旦在温暖的洋甘菊中发芽，就会被移入无加热的温室。

sentences: Hardy plants are those that tolerate the cold.
Some can take deep freezes and snow, others only mild winter chills.
It's worth finding out the hardiness rating of the crop you are sowing so you can cater to its needs.
After the seeds have germinated, any hardy seedlings can be relocated somewhere with plenty of light that is not too warm.
A cool, bright windowsill, conservatory, porch or cold frame would do.
translations: 耐寒植物是指那些能够忍受寒冷的植物。
有些能承受严寒和大雪，而另一些只能忍受温和的冬季寒冷。
了解你所播种作物的耐寒等级是值得的，这样你就能满足它的需求。
种子发芽后，任何耐寒的幼苗都可以被移到一个光线充足但不太温暖的地方。
一个凉爽、明亮的窗台、温室、门廊或冷床都可以。

sentences: The peas, which are also hardy, I drop into two trails running along the bottom of a trench in a vegetable bed.
The trench is about 15cm wide and 3cm deep, and the seeds fall about 5cm apart.
I pinch the soil back over them, pat it down and then tuck them in with a sheet of bubble wrap to protect them from the cold while they germinate.
Once they have grown a little I will give them pea netting to scrabble up.
translations: 豌豆同样耐寒，我将它们撒在菜床沟渠底部的两条轨迹上。
沟渠大约15厘米宽、3厘米深，种子间距约5厘米。
我将土壤捏回覆盖种子，拍实，然后用一层气泡膜包裹起来，在发芽期间保护它们免受寒冷。
一旦它们稍微长大，我会给它们豌豆网供攀爬。

sentences: Even without a sowing calendar, signs of rebirth outside tell us it's time to reach for our seeds.
Observing the gradual arrival of spring can help us adapt general guidance to our particular growing context; an invaluable skill that has benefits beyond the garden.
We now know all too well that being connected to the rest of the living world is important for our physical and emotional wellbeing.
translations: 即使没有播种日历，外界复苏的迹象也告诉我们该去取种子了。
观察春天的逐渐到来，能帮助我们根据具体的种植环境调整通用指南；这是一项宝贵的技能，其益处远不止于花园。
我们现在非常清楚，与生命世界保持联系对我们的身心健康至关重要。

sentences: Learning to be guided by cues from the wild can deepen our relationship with the living world and contextualise our gardens in the wider landscape, allowing us to experience ourselves as part of rather than separate from the rhythms of life on Earth.
translations: 学会遵循自然的指引，能够加深我们与生命世界的联系，并将我们的花园置于更广阔的景观背景中，让我们体验到自己是地球生命节奏的一部分，而非与之分离。
